movements.coachingCue: Stand side-on to the phone, whole body in frame.
Phone on the floor, side-on, about two metres away.
Side-on. Front foot flat and visible.
Face the phone, arms fully in frame overhead.
Side-on. Hold the hip angle straight — sagging stops the clock.
